description: This Java class `SaslResponseContext` stores and manages information related to the SASL handshake process in an AMQP connection within the Eclipse Hono project. It encapsulates details about the connection, SASL mechanism used, response fields, and peer certificates, providing factory methods for creating instances for specific mechanisms (PLAIN and EXTERNAL).

classes.name: SaslResponseContext
classes.description: A final class that maintains SASL handshake information in an AMQP connection, including mechanism type, response fields, peer certificates, and connection reference.

methods.name: forMechanismPlain
methods.description: Factory method to create a SaslResponseContext instance for the PLAIN SASL mechanism using the provided connection and response fields.

methods.name: forMechanismExternal
methods.description: Factory method to create a SaslResponseContext instance for the EXTERNAL SASL mechanism with the given connection and peer certificates.

methods.name: getPeerCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the peer certificate chain, or null if none was provided.

methods.name: getSaslResponseFields
methods.description: Returns the SASL response fields (authzid, authcid, pwd) if the PLAIN mechanism is used; otherwise null.

methods.name: getRemoteMechanism
methods.description: Returns the SASL mechanism used by the remote party.

methods.name: getProtonConnection
methods.description: Returns the ProtonConnection instance associated with this context.
